description.value: Participants moved disks across three vertical pegs to construct designated towers while following two rules.

spans.text: The objective is to move disks that vary in size from small to large across three vertical pegs to construct a designated tower displayed pictorially, in the fewest number of moves possible.

design_type.value: Continuous behavioral executive-function task with successive trials of increasing difficulty; not an event-related neuroimaging design.

instructions.value: Move one disk at a time across three vertical pegs to construct the displayed target tower in as few moves as possible; never move two disks at once and never place a larger disk over a smaller disk.
